messages:
jordan_sales: Hey team — ACME legal just asked for our SOC 2 report + a signed NDA before starting the POC. Can we confirm process/timeline?

maria_legal: We need a signed NDA before handing over unredacted SOC2 artifacts. We can provide a signed bridge/ack letter for limited-scope extracts while NDA is in flight, but need to scope it.

sam_eng: For the POC we can produce redacted SOC2 extracts and cfgs. Recommend presigned S3 for delivery (48h expiration). I can generate redacted logs + control matrices.

emily_security: +1 on presigned S3. If we do a bridge letter it should explicitly say "limited extracts only", retention 30 days, and no access to raw customer data. Security will review wording.

jordan_sales: Timeline from ACME: wants evidence access this week if possible. Is 48h for artifact prep + legal signoff realistic?

maria_legal: If ACME returns NDA today we can sign in ~24 hours. If not, we offer the bridge ack for extracts — but legal needs list of docs and a short justification.

sam_eng: I'll assemble the artifact list. Proposed items: "SOC2 Type II summary PDF (redacted), control mapping CSV (redacted IDs), runtime config snippets (no secrets), sample audit logs (anonymized)".

sam_eng: Presigned upload path I plan to use: s3://redwood-poc/evidence/ACME-2025/ -- will generate presigned GET links. Example presign command: 
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-poc/evidence/ACME-2025/soc2-redacted.pdf --expires-in 172800
```

emily_security: Also include a statement in the bridge note that we performed redaction and verification steps (hash of files, redaction checklist). We don't want to be back-and-forth on what was removed.

maria_legal: Jordan — can you ask ACME to confirm they accept presigned link delivery and temporary access? If they insist on full SOC2 package we need signed NDA first.

jordan_sales: Pinged ACME legal now. They replied: "Presigned links ok for POC but we need a brief ack letter stating scope. NDA is being routed but may take 3 business days."

emily_security: Ok — legal & security can draft a short ack letter. I suggest we include: scope list, retention window (30 days), no derivative data use, and contact for incident questions.

maria_legal: I'll draft the ack letter. Can someone confirm the exact filenames and redaction approach so I can reference them?

sam_eng: Will confirm filenames in ~2 hours. Plan: soc2-redacted.pdf, control-mapping.csv, runtime-configs.txt, sample-audit-logs.json. Redaction steps: tokenization of PII, zeroing host identifiers, strip IPs.

sys-ticket-bot: created ticket #POC-8429 for ACME SOC2 request (assignee: sam_eng)

jordan_sales: Thanks — once ack letter is ready and files uploaded I'll share links with ACME. Also flagging pricing: ACME asked whether there are any extra fees for expedited evidence access during POC. Anyone?

maria_legal: No legal fees. If they request on-site review or additional retained evidence we may discuss a professional services fee, but presigned extracts are covered under normal POC support.

emily_security: Security note: keep copies of delivered artifacts internally for 90 days for audit trail, but don't include any raw PII.

jordan_sales: Sounds good. Action items: sam -> prepare redacted files + upload; maria -> ack letter draft; emily -> quick review of ack wording; jordan -> confirm ACME concurs with presigned approach.

sam_eng: On it, I'll post filenames + presigned links once uploaded. ETA 6pm PT today.

maria_legal: I'll post ack letter here for quick sign-off before sending.

emily_security: I'll review asap. :thumbsup:

jordan_sales: Appreciate it everyone — will update ACME after we have the links and signed ack.
